context.body: Letters and visions inspect words, motives, weakness, healing, intercession, confidence, delay, and prayer before God’s throne. The bounded source is Revelation 8:1–5.

payload.posture: Read Revelation 8:1–5 as prayer interpreted and pictured evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The vision moves from heavenly silence and offered incense to altar fire and earthly phenomena without explaining a literal mechanism.
